guidebook.role.description.wathe:civilia:
This is the base civilian role. They have no unique features.

About Innocents:

Innocent's objective is to rid the train of all killers and accomplices.

Innocents can search the train for clues. Obtaining enough clues will grant them an emergency revolver. Emergency revolvers do not drop on death. Revolvers cannot be picked up if the innocent has an emergency revolver. They can use their emergency revolver to pick up the revolver, however.

Innocents who shoots another innocent will cause the shooter to die of guilt. Shooting Accomplices, Killers, or the Executioner's target do not cause the shooter to die.

They win with other civilians and vigilantes. They do not have to kill accomplices unless they have turned into a killer.
guidebook.role.description.wathe:vigilan:
This is the base vigilante role. They spawn with a revolver. They have no other unique features.

Their objective is to rid the train of all killers and accomplices.

If the vigilante dies, then their revolver drops. Unarmed innocents or the executioner can pick up the revolver. Revolvers that drop off the train will never appear back on again.

Innocents who shoots another innocent will cause the shooter to die of guilt. Shooting Accomplices, Killers, or the Executioner's target do not cause the shooter to die.

They win with other civilians and vigilantes. They do not have to kill accomplices unless they have turned into a killer.
guidebook.role.description.wathe:killer:
This is the base killer role. They have no unique features.

About Killers:

Killer's objective is to kill every non-killer player using the tools in their arsenal.

Killers can search the train for clues. Obtaining enough clues will grant them money. Killers cannot pick up dropped revolvers.

They win with other killers and killer accomplices. 

KILLER INSTINCT OVERHAUL:

Killer instinct has been overhauled entirely, and is now limited. Instinct is capped at 100% and drains whenever instinct is used.

Instinct becomes less reliable as the color changes. The range you can see lowers with continuous use, and seeing innocent mood colors become restricted. There are 4 sections of the instinct bar: 

  - Red (100-70%): Works like pre-nerfed instinct (infinite range). Can see up to depressive mood (Blue)

  - Orange (70-40%): See players up to 80 blocks away. Can only see up to stressed mood (Light blue).

  - Yellow (40-10%): See players up to 40 blocks away. Can only see up to content mood (Green)

  - Grey (10-0%): Same as yellow. You cannot use instinct unless you go above the gray threshold. Instinct can still be drained into gray however, just not used from it.

You gain back instinct overtime and by doing tasks (adds 15%). You will always see accomplices and killers regardless of your instinct bar %.

guidebook.role.description.starexpress:m:
A killer who has access to tape which can silence players on the train.

Duct tape is invisible in the hands of a killer, and taped passengers are not notified of being taped until much later.

Taped passengers cannot speak, and must have another passenger remove the tape to gain back their voice. Innocents who remove tape from others lose mood for doing so.

If the taped passenger's mood drops to 0, the passenger will die if the tape gets removed or are outside. They can also die if they stay outside for too long.
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
This role is disabled by default. But is planned to be reworked in the future.

Check back after it is announced to see how they work!

A vengeful accomplice who awaits for a specific passenger's demise.

Their objective is to get their target killed by non-killer means (Getting shot by another innocent or a non-killer assisted death). The target cannot be a vigilante or a killer.

The executioner can pick up a dropped gun and shoot their target directly, which will cause the executioner to drop the gun afterwards. Shooting a non-target will kill the executioner, however.

If the target is shot by another innocent, the shooter will not die from guilt. If the target dies from killer means, then the target switches to another random target.

The executioner can use their ability to force randomize their target. Upon successfully get their target killed, they become another random killer.

Executioners can be seen by other killer roles as a cohort, but the Executioner cannot see who else is a killer. They can see their target at all times.

Accomplices do not have to be killed for an innocent win unless they have become another killer.

A killer who has the ability to disguise themselves to appear as any other living passenger on the %1$s.

Disguises last for 45 seconds, and cannot disguise for 30 seconds afterwards. Morphlings can force their disguise to end using their ability.

If the passenger that they are disguised as dies in any way, their disguise will be removed and their identity will be revealed.

A killer who has the ability allows them to turn invisible for 20 seconds on a 60 second cooldown. This ability has 3 charges.

When invisible, anything they hold and particles from sprinting will remain visible to others. Invisibility does not mute their footsteps.

A killer who has the ability to swap any player with any other player, teleporting both players to the other's location. This can include the swapper themself.

This role is disabled due to it's overpowered nature in-game. In the event of this role ever being enabled, then inform an operator of it's existence so it can be disabled again.

An accomplice who hungers for bodies on the train. The Vulture has the ability to consume bodies. Bodies that have been consumed will hide the time of death and role of the body.

Once they have "consumed" enough bodies, they will become a random killer role.

When a Vulture consumes a body, they will have slowness with particles for a very short time, and a sound cue will play. Be mindful of any light blue particles and consumption sounds that emit from another passenger!

This accomplice cannot pick up a dropped revolver.

Vultures can be seen by other killer roles as a cohort, but the Vulture cannot see who else is a killer.

Accomplices do not have to be killed for an innocent win unless they have become another killer.

guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
A killer who is able to hear dead people.

This is mostly a joke killer role, and is disabled. However, it may occasionally be enabled due to admin shenanigans, so be mindful when you get this role.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:conduc: It's not a Lockpick I Swear
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
The driver of the %1$s who has access to every room on the train.

The Conductor holds a Master Key, which grants access to every locked door on the %1$s. This item is dropped on death, which can be picked up by killers.

If there are less than 10 passengers aboard the %1$s, the Conductor's Master Keys will appear as Lockpicks.

An innocent who can see poisoned food/drink trays, buy drinks for themselves, and see any passenger that drinks a beverage.

Passengers who drink will be glowed to the bartender for 10 seconds.

Drinks cost 75 coins for the bartender, and have no special abilities associated with them.

Food/Drink trays that have been poisoned will emit pink clouds from it.

An innocent whose body will glow upon meeting their demise.

Noisemakers gain 50 coins per task completed and 5 coins at passive intervals, which can be used to purchase Firecrackers.

An innocent who can use an emergency teleport to get out of a sticky situation.

They can set a location by using their ability, then teleport back to that location by using their ability again. This teleport only has one use.

Teleporting costs 200 coins. The Recaller gains 50 coins per task completed.

An innocent who can read dead bodies.

They are able to see the time of death and role of a passenger body. If the body was consumed by the vulture, then the information will be scrambled on the body.

They are the only innocent role that can confirm the presence of a vulture without directly seeing or hearing them consume a body.

Makes the passenger short.

Yeah, you're short now. Deal with it.

Makes the passenger part Chameleon.

Standing still will slowly cause you to blend into your surroundings. Moving or being collided with causes you to appear visible again.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:guesse: Hey Guys my Role is Death By Voodoo Magic
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Gives a killer the ability to guess the role of any non-killer player.

Successfully guessing correctly will cause the victim to die immediately. Guessing incorrectly will cause the guesser to die.

This modifier can only be assigned to killers.

Gives a killer the ability to see information about dead bodies like the Coroner does.

This modifier can only be assigned to killers.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:feathe: Nuh uh Can't Body Block Me
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Makes the passenger fall slowly and unable to collide with other players.

These unique abilities can allow the passenger to fall off the side of the train and still have time to save themselves.
